title: Two crafts. One studio.
intro: GDUXI brings two crafts together: graphic design and UX/UI design. We each bring our own expertise, and we bring it to every project as one team.
story_quote: GD + UX/uI: graphic design and UX/UI as one practice. We design the mark and the experience together, so the join never shows.
story_body: The name says it plainly: GD for graphic design, UXI for UX/UI. Our colours flow from cobalt into violet and orchid, and the wave lines come from our own banner work.

values.title: Research before pixels
values.body: We listen to your customers before we design for them, so every decision comes with a reason you can see.

values.title: Craft you can feel
values.body: Hand-drawn marks and calm, considered interfaces. Nothing off a template, and made by people, so it doesn't look like everything else.

values.title: No surprises
values.body: A fixed quote before we start, clear milestones and regular check-ins. You'll always know where things stand and what's next.
